# Load order: TGR -> PSC -> KAI -> E&F -> ... -> megapack -> [VC] -> ... -> Grey's pack -> THIS.
# Why this file exists: grey_usu REPLACE_OR_CREATEs all four vanilla construction methods with bodies that put country_construction_add back and drop PSC's goods_output_*_construction -- which decouples the whole PSC chain: the construction regulator loses its input and PSC's four construction goods lose their only producer. It also eats E&F's stock line. Bodies copied from the megapack's zz_pb_ef_construction_pm.txt. !! MAINTENANCE !! re-run whenever that file changes.

# PSC's construction chain (goods out, no country_construction_add) with E&F's stock
# line, from the megapack merge. Victorian Century's layer is NOT here: GR.1 puts it
# back by re-issuing VC's own INJECT: in _greys/greys+vc done/common/
# production_methods/zz_gvc_methods.txt, which loads after this file (zz_greys_ < zz_gvc_).

REPLACE:pm_wooden_buildings = {
	texture = "gfx/interface/icons/production_method_icons/wooden_buildings.dds"
	
	is_default = yes

	building_modifiers = {
		workforce_scaled = {
			# input goods
			goods_input_fabric_add = 25
			goods_input_wood_add = 75

			# output goods (PSC)
			goods_output_wood_construction_add = 20

			# output goods (E&F)
			goods_output_manufacture_stock_add = 20 #50
		}

		level_scaled = {
			building_employment_engineers_add = 40
			building_employment_clerks_add = 100
			building_employment_laborers_add = 860
		}
		unscaled = {
			building_laborers_mortality_mult = 0.1
		}
	}

	# Guard, not PSC's line. grey_usu's body puts vanilla's country_construction_add
	# back into country_modifiers, and PSC's chain replaces construction points with
	# goods output -- both together would count construction twice. Under "REPLACE:
	# replaces the record" this block is a no-op; under "REPLACE: patches the named
	# sub-blocks" (the question still open in the rules) it is what clears USU's.
	country_modifiers = { workforce_scaled = { } }
}
